$comment: Size budgets of the repository's own documentation, checked by `node .ci/scripts/check-doc-budgets.ts` (blocking CI job + a Claude Code PostToolUse hook that warns right after an edit). Why: ADR-0001's hub was compacted on 2026-09-18 and was back at 116 KB nine days later, because every pass appended a dated report and nothing bounded it. Roles: `living` = re-read at every resume, so bounded (`maxKB`, 1 KB = 1000 bytes); `archive` = write-once (frozen step, journal, closed ADR) — exempt, but flagged if it grows in a PR; `exempt` = generated, legal or product docs with their own lifecycle; `step` = living while the step's **Status:** line is open (⬜/🟦), archive once closed (✅/🧊/🚫). Any file under docs/adr-<n>/ becomes archive once that ADR's hub **Status:** says Closed or Abandoned. First matching rule wins; a tracked .md file matching none takes `default`. Raising a budget is a decision: say why in the commit, never to let a journal through.

default.advice: a reference document describes the present, it does not narrate sessions: cut the history (git keeps it) or move it to the open step of the governing ADR

rules.why: product documentation (docs.kuzzle.io), versioned with its own lifecycle

rules.advice: open step too heavy: sub-split it (one file per part under steps/NN-<slug>/, each with its own **Status:** line, see the kuzzle-adr skill), or evict the settled parts verbatim to docs/adr-<n>/journal.md with a pointer

ADR hub: decision + cold start + step table + register (one line per decision). A step's narrative goes in its steps/NN-*.md; a journal already written is evicted verbatim to journal.md with a pointer
ADR annex (register, inventory, lessons): what is settled moves to journal.md or to the frozen step that produced it
the v3 backlog grows by design, but by one row per item: the rationale goes in the PR or ADR the row links to, not in the cell
loaded at EVERY session: keep only durable one- or two-line rules and pitfalls; the story of a pitfall goes in the step that found it, with a link
CLAUDE.md should only import AGENTS.md: edit AGENTS.md
contributor rules, not their history: the reason behind a rule is one sentence and a link to the ADR step or issue
a skill gives the method, not the history of its passes: move reports to the governing ADR's step, and long gotchas to a reference file next to SKILL.md
